resources.string: Choose what the app downloads by itself on each network. Manual downloads always work.
Turns off all automatic downloads on mobile data, roaming and metered Wi-Fi. The Download button keeps working.
Secret chats, disappearing photos and spoiler attachments are never downloaded automatically.
The Download button on an attachment always downloads it, even above the limit.
Fast-start videos can play while downloading. If the file index is at the end, the video opens after the full download.
